svg.text: ORDER BY "_order", "Region" IS NULL, "Region" COLLATE NOCASE, "Region"
Read-only. It is what the pivot asks Sales; change the fields and it changes.
Made from the fields in the panel.
Q1–Q3 are the Quarter values now in
Sales; a new quarter adds a column.
Runs on the same read-only engine
Want to change it by hand?
Convert it to a SQL query. The cells
stay as they are; the pivot object
becomes a SQL() result. Undo brings
Pivot 4 · Show as SQL: the bridge from a pivot to a query
Show Pivot Table as SQL… (Ctrl+Alt+Q) shows what the pivot asks. A pivot is a special query, so the user can see that.
Convert to SQL query… turns the pivot into a SQL() result of the same name; from then on it is edited as SQL. One undo step.
